people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: With great power, the apostles gave their testimony of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus. Great grace was on them all.
translations.bsb: With great power the apostles continued to give their testimony about the resurrection of the Lord Jesus. And abundant grace was upon them all.
translations.kjv: And with great power gave the apostles witness of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus: and great grace was upon them all.
translations.asv: And with great power gave the apostles their witness of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus: and great grace was upon them all.
